en: The image depicts the reverse side of a postcard with a cream background. On the right side, there is a formal printed inscription 'Härra K. Ruble' in a decorative script. Above this text, there is a coat of arms with the name 'KAWE' inside a shield. On the left side, handwritten text reads: 'TLM-28131:29 Saadud Karl Ruenilt'. The layout and style suggest it is an older, possibly early-to-mid 20th century postcard.
